nodes.text:
I have not asked anybody for anything in forty years and I am about to spoil it.

Put his name on the stone. Halla will say she cannot write what she cannot bury. Let her say it to you instead of to me.
She is right. That has never once been the same thing as being finished.

choices.text: Then I will speak to her.

nodes.text: Aslak. Do not soften it and do not make a speech of it. Say the name and let her do the rest.
